original_source: Projects failed to load for  20 min. Things are back to normal.
failure_pattern: During the incident, the backend service responsible for loading discovery projects failed, causing project load errors for users. The failure persisted until the service was restored, after which normal operation resumed.
mitigation_principle: Implement health checks and graceful degradation; add circuit breaker; monitor project load metrics; set up alerting for load failures; ensure fallback UI.

original_source: You may face intermittent errors across the application
failure_pattern: Intermittent errors were caused by a misconfiguration in the backend service, leading to failures when opening projects, editing fields, or viewing data points. The issue persisted for a couple of days before being resolved after identifying the root cause and applying a fix.
mitigation_principle: Implement automated configuration validation; add health checks and circuit breakers; monitor key metrics; enforce change management; conduct regular post-incident reviews

original_source: Jira Product Discovery performance degradation
failure_pattern: A configuration error in the Jira Product Discovery service caused a performance degradation that rendered the service unusable for most US customers and some non-US customers, affecting operations such as opening projects, creating/deleting fields, and adding/viewing data points.
mitigation_principle: Implement automated health checks and alerting for performance metrics; enforce configuration validation and change management; perform capacity planning and load testing; roll out canary deployments to detect regressions early.

original_source: Issue editing idea descriptions (workaround available)
symptoms: blank editor when attempting to edit idea description
unable to edit description until page refresh
failure_pattern: When a user clicks to edit an idea description, the editor component fails to load the existing content and renders a blank editor. The failure is caused by a missing or corrupted state in the frontend rendering logic, which prevents the editor from initializing correctly. Refreshing the page reloads the state, allowing the editor to display the content and become editable.
mitigation_principle: 1. Validate editor state before rendering; 2. Add unit and integration tests for editor initialization; 3. Implement fallback UI for missing data; 4. Monitor editor load errors in production; 5. Use feature flags to roll out fixes gradually

original_source: JPD not able to refresh insights coming from Jira Cloud
failure_pattern: The backend service responsible for fetching insights from Jira Cloud failed to refresh due to an unexpected response or connectivity issue with the Jira API, causing the Capture feature to be unable to add or view data points.
mitigation_principle: Implement retry logic with exponential backoff; add circuit breaker to isolate third‑party failures; monitor API health and latency; log detailed error context; set up alerts for API outages; provide graceful degradation or cached data for users.

original_source: Some users were unable to access their discovery projects
symptoms: Misleading error indicating deletion or permission change
Users unable to access open projects
failure_pattern: A bug in the backend permission‑checking logic caused the system to incorrectly flag existing projects as unavailable, resulting in a misleading error message for users attempting to access open projects.
mitigation_principle: 1. Add unit tests for permission checks covering all error paths; 2. Implement separate error codes for deletion vs permission issues; 3. Add monitoring to detect unexpected error messages; 4. Conduct code reviews focused on error handling logic; 5. Deploy automated alerts for permission‑related failures.

original_source: Issues with the list view: ranking ideas, performance
symptoms: incorrect ranking of ideas when multi-select field is present
failure_pattern: The ranking algorithm in the list view incorrectly handled multi-select fields, causing the ranking of ideas to be broken and overall performance to degrade.
mitigation_principle: Add unit tests for ranking logic; add integration tests for multi-select scenarios; perform code reviews focusing on edge cases; monitor ranking correctness in production

original_source: Issues moving ideas in a board with 'status' field
symptoms: drag and drop of ideas on board not working
ideas cannot be moved between columns
failure_pattern: The drag-and-drop functionality failed because the status field mapping for board columns was misconfigured, causing the UI to not recognize the target column when moving ideas.
mitigation_principle: 1. Validate status field mappings during deployment; 2. Add unit tests for drag-and-drop logic; 3. Implement runtime checks for column existence; 4. Monitor drag-and-drop events for anomalies.

original_source: Some formulas don't work (will be fixed by Monday)
failure_pattern: A bug in the formula engine caused divide operations to fail, leading to formula fields not working in some cases.
mitigation_principle: 1. Add unit tests for all formula operations; 2. Implement runtime validation for divide operations; 3. Enforce code review for formula engine changes; 4. Monitor formula execution errors in production

original_source: Jira Cloud website outage
failure_pattern: Steady traffic growth caused the number of simultaneous connections to the EC2‑based DNS servers to reach the AWS security group connection tracking limit, leading to dropped DNS packets. The dropped packets produced SERVFAIL responses, which triggered retries and further increased connections, compounding the problem until the DNS infrastructure was overwhelmed and services could not resolve addresses, resulting in application failures.
mitigation_principle: Implement monitoring for network connection tracking limits and packet drops; add circuit breaker or untracked connections to avoid consuming SG limits; increase capacity or migrate to VPC resolver; add alerting for approaching limits; perform capacity planning and load testing

original_source: Automation and sending feedback and file support issue
symptoms: Jira and Confluence events not received
failure_pattern: An outage of AWS API Gateway and Lambda prevented events from Jira and Confluence from reaching the Automation service, causing automation rules to fail and creating a backlog that was processed only after the services recovered.
mitigation_principle: 1. Implement retry and exponential backoff for third‑party integrations; 2. Add circuit breaker and health checks for external services; 3. Queue events locally and replay on recovery; 4. Monitor third‑party service status and set up alerts; 5. Diversify or add redundancy for critical integrations.

original_source: Issues in new product activations, user management and user imports
failure_pattern: A misconfiguration in the shared user management service caused failures in product activations, user imports, and related features across Confluence, Jira, and related products, leading to inability to open projects, create/delete fields, and view data points. The issue persisted for several hours before being resolved.
mitigation_principle: Implement automated configuration validation; add health checks for shared services; monitor key metrics; enforce rollback procedures; conduct post-incident reviews

original_source: Intermittent errors during login for some customers
failure_pattern: A misconfiguration in the shared authentication service caused intermittent login failures across multiple Atlassian cloud services, leading to authentication errors for users. The issue was identified and mitigated, restoring normal operation.
mitigation_principle: Implement automated configuration validation; add health checks for authentication service; deploy canary releases for authentication changes; establish rollback procedures; monitor authentication metrics

original_source: Performance issues and outages with Cloud products
symptoms: slow loading and uploading of attachments
inability for new customers to sign up

mitigation_principle: Implement upgrade freeze for non‑critical components; enhance scaling resilience of critical infrastructure; isolate components to prevent cascading failures; enforce stricter testing and validation before releases.

original_source: Atlassian services unable to scale
failure_pattern: A scaling failure caused resource exhaustion across multiple services, leading to degraded performance for all Atlassian cloud customers.

original_source: Media outage affecting multiple Atlassian services
symptoms: service unavailable for Confluence, Jira, Bitbucket, and other Atlassian Cloud services
failure_pattern: A network change was applied that disrupted the media service, causing media attachments to fail across multiple Atlassian Cloud services. The issue was resolved by reverting the change.

original_source: Multiple product logins
failure_pattern: A change to network extensions in the Edge Network unintentionally modified multiple Set-Cookie headers, leaving only the last header in the response. This caused the authentication service to drop session cookies, preventing new sessions from being established and resulting in login failures for users.
mitigation_principle: Implement automated tests for cookie handling; ensure network extension configs are identical in staging and production; use progressive rollouts for network changes; improve staging coverage for multi-cookie responses

original_source: Sign-ups, Product Activation, and Billing not working
failure_pattern: A misconfiguration in the backend services caused the sign-up, product activation, and billing functionalities to fail, affecting all cloud customers.

original_source: Slowness and intermittent failure while creating new Cloud instances

original_source: Small cohort of customers are unable to access JSW/JWM/JSM/JPD
symptoms: access failures for a small cohort of customers
unable to access Jira Software, Jira Work Management, Jira Service Management, and Jira Product Discovery

original_source: Atlassian Account login issues
failure_pattern: A misconfigured rate limit in an internal service caused excessive 429 responses, triggering retries that multiplied load and cascaded through dependent services, leading to widespread authentication failures.

original_source: Degraded performance in Cloud

mitigation_principle: Implement multi-AZ redundancy for networking resources; monitor network mapping propagation delays; add fallback routing and health checks for network connectivity; document and test AZ failure scenarios; enforce network mapping consistency across regions; automate alerts for network latency and connectivity issues

original_source: Infrastructure outage affecting attachments and Bitbucket Pipelines in all regions

failure_pattern: A major infrastructure outage prevented scaling up, causing Bitbucket Pipelines and attachment storage to become unavailable, leading to degraded performance across all products.

original_source: Email domain unverified
symptoms: Email notifications sent from default atlassian.net domain instead of custom domain
Domain verification failure notifications sent to admins
Customers with custom domain notifications experienced service disruption
failure_pattern: A change to the custom domain email notification lifecycle service added SPF record validation to the daily job, causing previously verified custom domains to become unverified. This caused the system to fall back to sending notifications from the default atlassian.net domain, leading to customers receiving incorrect emails and service disruption.
mitigation_principle: Implement automated validation of configuration changes before deployment; add monitoring and alerting for custom domain lifecycle regressions; enforce code review and testing for changes affecting domain verification; maintain a rollback plan for critical services

original_source: Forge Function Invocations outage impacting Smartlinks

original_source: Jira Automation rules failed when sending out emails

original_source: Atlassian's cross product user search service is currently degraded.

mitigation_principle: Implement a queue for computationally intensive operations; fine‑tune clustered database settings; add rate limiting and backpressure; monitor memory usage and set alerts; scale infrastructure during spikes

original_source: Egress connectivity timing out

original_source: Some customers aren't receiving email notification when exporting users from User Management
